scopeBoundary: This matrix audits construction of the fixed-C0 analytic input. It does not claim an unconditional Lean proof of NO-LOG or any support for EXP-EPS.

sourceObjects.beforeDeletion: Distinct signed squarefree t=F(a,b)/w^2 with a bounded positive-box witness in the fixed congruence class.
sourceObjects.badObjects: Chosen witness parameters q_t=tau(a_t/b_t) lying in the KL thin set Omega.
sourceObjects.afterDeletion: Distinct negative squarefree t outside Omega, each yielding a distinct desired imaginary quadratic field.
sourceObjects.fieldCount: N(X)=N^-_{5,2}(X) restricted to natural discriminant bounds X.

normalizationIssue.claim: The source lower bound #T_H >= c H^2 with arbitrary real c>0 does not directly imply 2*m*H^2 <= rawCount(H) for a positive natural m.
normalizationIssue.failureSignal: Taking the same box height H and m>=1 would demand at least 2H^2 distinct raw values, while the positive H-box contains at most H^2 parameter pairs.
normalizationIssue.requiredRepair: Choose a fixed integer scale L with cL^2 sufficiently large, define all counts at source height LH, and multiply the discriminant constant by L^6. The L^2/L^6 propagation is kernel verified; choosing L from the source real c and constructing the maximal selector remain explicit external elementary obligations.

fieldMappings.source: Enlarge H0 so the fixed linear exceptional term is at most the normalized quadratic main term.
Every raw value is either outside Omega (good) or its chosen witness lies in Omega (thin).
Outside Omega, KL Theorem 4.1 and the local sign conditions give 5-rank>=2 imaginary fields; signed squarefree t give distinct fields.
The set counted at discriminant bound x is included in that counted at y whenever x<=y.
Natural-number normalization of the real Vinogradov and O-constants after fixed height scaling.
Choose a sixth-root height for the normalized integer discriminant constant; maximality gives both-sided comparison after enlarging X0.
fieldMappings.risk: The same selector must satisfy both inequalities. A convenient natural construction is the maximal H with D*H^6<=X; then (H+1)^6 controls X by a fixed multiple of H^6.

minimalSourceAlignedInterface.purpose: The published strong KL lemma is already stated after thin deletion, so this interface avoids inventing pre-deletion counts when only the post-deletion quadratic family is needed.
minimalSourceAlignedInterface.boundary: It remains conditional on a normalized post-deletion quadratic count, field injection, monotonicity and a two-sided sixth-degree selector.

rationalSourceInterface.repair: Encode a positive rational p/q below the source real constant as p*T^2 <= q*goodCount(T); use T=qH, mainConstant=pq, discriminantConstant=Dq^6, and a kernel-constructed maximal sixth-root selector.
remainingExternalInputs: The source-supported post-deletion strong KL lower bound and its uniform quantifiers
Existence of a positive rational p/q below the positive real Vinogradov constant
The fixed-C0 goodCount object and source injection into desired fields
Monotonicity of the intended field-count function

sourceInstantiationLedger.quantifierOrder: After fixing C0 and the localization data, choose once and for all c>0, real H_source>0 and real C_delta>0 from the strong KL lemma; then choose positive naturals p,q with p/q<=c, a natural H0>=H_source, and a positive natural D>=C_delta. These constants precede every natural height T and discriminant bound X.
sourceInstantiationLedger.goodCountDefinition: For natural T, goodCount(T) is the finite cardinality of the already post-thin-deletion set T_T in strong-kl-no-log-lemma.md; its elements are distinct negative squarefree t with a fixed-class bounded witness and tau(a/b) outside Omega.
sourceInstantiationLedger.rationalCountDerivation: For every natural T>=H0, #T_T>=c*T^2 and p/q<=c imply p*T^2<=q*#T_T after multiplying the real inequality by q and using that both sides are natural numbers.
sourceInstantiationLedger.heightDerivation: Every t in T_T gives a distinct desired field with absolute discriminant <=C_delta*T^6<=D*T^6, so goodCount(T)<=N(D*T^6).
sourceInstantiationLedger.monotonicityDerivation: N(x)<=N(y) for x<=y by inclusion of the field sets defined by the discriminant cutoff.

fixedSourceObligations.positiveConeAndFixedCongruence: Built into the definition of T_T through positive bounded witnesses in one fixed residue class.
fixedSourceObligations.classWiseMaximalFixedSquare: The t in T_T satisfy F(a,b)=t*w^2 for the maximal w of that same fixed residue class.
fixedSourceObligations.boundedWitnessForEachSquarefreeValue: Each counted t has a witness 1<=a,b<=T from the same Stewart-Top positive box.
fixedSourceObligations.thinParameterInjectionAndLocalRank: tau(a/b) is outside Omega; the signed-squarefree injection and KL local theorem give a distinct imaginary quadratic field of 5-rank at least 2.

sourceInstantiationLedger.kernelBoundary: Lean receipt lean-b450b5f91e03836f8ae94187 starts from the natural p,q,D,H0 ledger above; it does not prove rational density, Archimedean ceiling choices, or the Stewart-Top/Kulkarni-Levin source facts.

falsification.hypothesis: The frozen strong KL lemma directly instantiates every field of NoLogInference.AnalyticBridge at the same box height.
falsification.test: Compare the coefficient domains and literal cardinality bounds before defining counts; reject direct instantiation if the natural main coefficient forces more values than the H-box can contain.
falsification.repairRoute: fixed height rescaling plus a source-aligned post-deletion bridge
